reviews.author: YO LEE
reviews.text: This is a foreign gallery located in Cheongdam-dong. It is known as the largest gallery in Asia, and is said to have opened in 2022, following Bangkok, Beijing, and Hong Kong. Because it was located underground, the scale was hard to tell, but I was surprised at how much bigger it was than I expected. The first and second basement levels have a 6-meter-high ceiling, making it possible to display large-scale works. There was currently an exhibition being held on China's next-generation painter named Yang Yong, and it suited my personal taste well, so I had a lot of fun watching it. The exhibition runs until July 13th.

reviews.author: un promeneur solitaire
reviews.text:
⠀⠀⠀⠀
⠀Unpack Reveal Unleash
⠀⠀⠀⠀2023. 10. 20 ~ 2023. 11. 25
⠀⠀⠀
At Tang Contemporary Art, you can see the group exhibition “Unpack Reveal Unleash” with seven artists. Artists from various nationalities and backgrounds, including Korean artists Di Renli, Jang Qual, and Yun Hyeop, gather together to fill the exhibition hall. Although each of them is telling a unique story and expressing it in a different way, all seven artists move the viewer's heart. There is a saying, ‘I exist only when I have you.’ When you look at a work of art, don't you think, 'Hmm, this artist has similar thoughts to me in this regard, or 'Hmm, this artist has slightly different aesthetic tastes than me in this regard'? In order to know who I am, I must know the ‘you’ who is different from me, and my existence begins with distinguishing myself from ‘you’. I think it would be great to learn about 7 contemporary artists through this exhibition, and to take the time to learn more about myself. - Excerpt from exhibition introduction

Advantages: An exhibition that you can believe and see

Cons: It's too small... It's a little bigger... I want to see more works.
